ownershipRegressionAndFix.evidenceBefore: stat: capafy-publisher.json uid=0 gid=0 mode=0600 nlink=1; config.json/.env/browser-auth-state.json/resolution.json all uid=0.
ownershipRegressionAndFix.fix: chown 10001:10001 + chmod 0600 on the slot and the four materialized files, executed in-VM as root.
ownershipRegressionAndFix.rootCause: The merge exec ran as root (Maritime exec euid=0) and rewrote the slot via mkstemp+os.replace, leaving the slot AND all resolver-materialized files (config.json, .env, browser-auth-state.json, resolution.json) owned by uid 0. The in-cycle resolver runs as uid 10001 (run-cycle setpriv) and publisher_resolution._private_file requires st_uid == euid, so _load_slot failed with slot_unavailable and cycles 004-006 returned deferred/provider_binding_unresolvable.
ownershipRegressionAndFix.verifiedAfter: publisher_resolution.py run as uid 10001 via /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=10001 --regid=10001 --clear-groups returned RC 0: status=resolved, accountVerified=true, browserSeeded=true, resolvedAt 2026-11-07T00:32:57.859480+00:00; all five files remain uid 10001 afterwards.
